scenario: 把原始 CLIP 嵌入做成生产级视觉搜索(Pinterest Lens / Google Lens):用户拍一张图,返回相似商品并可按属性筛选。
scenario_en: Turning raw CLIP embeddings into production visual search (Pinterest Lens / Google Lens): a user snaps a photo, gets similar products, and can filter by attribute.
q: 生产级视觉搜索的三大架构决策是什么？
q_en: What are the three architectural decisions of production visual search?
why: 三大决策:(1)CLIP 编码器配置(zero-shot/联合微调/区域特征)决定检索质量;(2)跨模态 re-ranking——快速 ANN 召回后,用融合打分重排;(3)属性抽取头,给结果做 faceted 筛选(颜色/风格/品类)。L5+ 会追问 modality gap、微调时的 alignment drift、延迟预算。
why_en: Three decisions: CLIP encoder config for retrieval, cross-modal re-ranking after fast ANN recall, and attribute-extraction heads for faceted filtering — with senior probes on the modality gap, alignment drift, and latency budgets.
diagram:
flowchart LR Q["查询图"] --> E["CLIP 图像编码器"] E --> A["ANN 召回 top-k"] A --> R["跨模态 re-rank
融合三路分数"] R --> F["属性头 faceted 筛选"] F --> O["结果"]
options: (1)选向量数据库 (2)选 CDN (3)选前端框架
(1)CLIP 编码器配置(检索) (2)跨模态 re-ranking (3)属性抽取头(faceted 筛选)
(1)训练一个从零的图像分类器 (2)接入支付 (3)做用户画像
(1)只用 zero-shot CLIP (2)不做重排 (3)不做属性筛选,越简单越好
options_en: (1) pick a vector DB, (2) pick a CDN, (3) pick a frontend framework.
(1) CLIP encoder config (retrieval), (2) cross-modal re-ranking, (3) attribute-extraction heads (faceted filtering).
(1) train an image classifier from scratch, (2) integrate payments, (3) build user profiles.
(1) use only zero-shot CLIP, (2) skip re-ranking, (3) skip attribute filtering — simpler is better.
optionExplanations: 向量库/CDN/前端是周边基建,不是视觉搜索的模型架构决策。
对;编码器配置、re-ranking、属性头正是本课三大决策,分别管检索质量、排序、筛选。
从零训分类器绕开了 CLIP 的跨模态检索能力,支付/画像也与本题无关。
全省掉重排和属性筛选会牺牲相关性和可筛选体验,不是合理架构。
optionExplanations_en: Vector DB/CDN/frontend are peripheral infra, not the visual-search model decisions.
Correct — encoder config, re-ranking, and attribute heads are the lesson's three decisions, governing retrieval quality, ordering, and filtering.
Training a classifier from scratch bypasses CLIP's cross-modal retrieval, and payments/profiles are off-topic.
Dropping re-ranking and attribute filtering sacrifices relevance and filterability — not a sound architecture.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用对比学习把图像和文本编码进同一潜空间的模型,支持零样本跨模态检索。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) encodes images and text into one shared latent space via contrastive learning, enabling zero-shot cross-modal retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把结果按属性(颜色/风格/品类)拆成可勾选的维度,让用户逐维过滤。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Faceted filtering breaks results into checkable attribute dimensions (color/style/category) so users filter per facet.

scenario: 为什么 CLIP 一训练完就能直接拿图搜文、拿文搜图,不用为每个类别单独训分类器。
scenario_en: Why CLIP can do image-to-text and text-to-image search right after training, without per-category classifiers.
q: CLIP 的对比学习目标训出了什么,带来什么能力？
q_en: What does CLIP's contrastive objective train, and what capability does it give?
why: CLIP 用对比目标把图像编码器和文本编码器联合训进同一个共享潜空间——匹配的图文对拉近、不匹配的推远。结果是图像和文本嵌入可直接比余弦,实现零样本跨模态检索(拿图搜相近文本描述,反之亦然),无需为新类别重训。
why_en: CLIP jointly trains image and text encoders into one shared latent space by pulling matched image-text pairs together, so image and text embeddings are directly comparable by cosine for zero-shot cross-modal retrieval.
options: 把图像和文本编码器联合训进同一共享潜空间,匹配对拉近,得到零样本跨模态检索能力
为每个商品类别单独训一个分类器,靠投票检索
只训图像编码器,文本靠人工打标签对齐
训一个生成模型,靠生成描述再做字符串匹配
options_en: Jointly trains image and text encoders into one shared latent space, pulling matched pairs together, giving zero-shot cross-modal retrieval.
Trains a separate classifier per product category and retrieves by voting.
Trains only the image encoder, aligning text via manual labels.
Trains a generative model that writes captions, then does string matching.
optionExplanations: 对;联合对比训练造出共享潜空间,图文嵌入可直接比余弦,零样本跨模态检索。
逐类别分类器不具跨模态检索能力,新类别还要重训,与 CLIP 思路相反。
只训图像编码器无法对齐文本空间,人工打标对齐不到潜空间层面。
生成描述+字符串匹配丢掉了语义嵌入,退回到脆弱的关键词匹配。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — joint contrastive training builds a shared space where image/text embeddings compare by cosine for zero-shot cross-modal retrieval.
Per-category classifiers lack cross-modal retrieval and need retraining for new categories — opposite to CLIP.
Training only the image encoder can't align the text space, and manual labels don't align at the latent-space level.
Caption generation plus string matching drops the semantic embedding and reverts to brittle keyword matching.

termDefinitions.term: shared latent space / 共享潜空间
termDefinitions.meaning: 图像和文本被编码到同一向量空间,匹配的图文距离近,可直接跨模态比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shared latent space encodes images and text into one vector space where matched pairs are close, allowing direct cross-modal comparison.

termDefinitions.meaning: 无需为新类别再训练,直接用已学的嵌入完成检索/分类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Zero-shot means retrieving or classifying new categories directly from learned embeddings without extra training.

scenario: 即使训得很好的 CLIP,拿一张查询图去找它最近的文本嵌入,返回的描述常常不是最相关的。
scenario_en: Even with well-trained CLIP, an image's nearest text embeddings are often not the most relevant descriptions.
q: 为什么图像的最近文本邻居未必最相关？这是什么现象？
q_en: Why are an image's nearest text neighbors not necessarily the most relevant, and what is this phenomenon?
why: 这是 modality gap:即便共享潜空间,视觉和文本嵌入仍聚成两个不同的子空间,跨模态余弦系统性地低于同模态余弦。于是拿图直接比文本的原始余弦会偏,不能盲信——这正是要在 re-ranking 里加一路专门的 cross-modal alignment 学习分数、而不是只用原始余弦的原因。
why_en: It's the modality gap: even in a shared space, visual and text embeddings cluster in distinct subspaces and cross-modality cosine is systematically lower than within-modality, so raw image-to-text cosine is biased.
options: 因为 CLIP 没训好,再多训几轮就没这个问题了
modality gap:视觉与文本嵌入聚成不同子空间,跨模态余弦系统性偏低,原始图-文余弦不可盲信
因为文本编码器坏了,换个文本模型即可
因为图像分辨率不够,提高分辨率就能对齐
options_en: Because CLIP wasn't trained enough; a few more epochs remove it.
The modality gap: visual and text embeddings cluster in distinct subspaces and cross-modality cosine is systematically lower, so raw image-to-text cosine can't be trusted blindly.
Because the text encoder is broken; swap the text model.
Because image resolution is too low; raising resolution aligns them.
optionExplanations: modality gap 是对比训练的结构性现象,不是训练不足,多训不消除。
对;跨模态余弦系统性低于同模态,所以要用学习的 alignment 分数矫正,不能只信原始余弦。
文本编码器没坏,gap 来自两个模态嵌入的子空间分离,换模型不解决。
分辨率与 modality gap 无关,这是嵌入空间几何而非像素问题。
optionExplanations_en: The modality gap is a structural phenomenon of contrastive training, not undertraining, and more epochs don't remove it.
Correct — cross-modality cosine is systematically lower than within-modality, so a learned alignment score corrects it rather than trusting raw cosine.
The text encoder isn't broken; the gap comes from subspace separation between modalities, and swapping models doesn't fix it.
Resolution is unrelated to the modality gap, which is embedding-space geometry, not pixels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 共享空间里视觉与文本嵌入各自聚成不同子空间,跨模态余弦低于同模态余弦。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The modality gap is that visual and text embeddings occupy distinct subspaces in the shared space, making cross-modality cosine lower than within-modality.

scenario: 要为一个特定领域商品目录(如时尚)选 CLIP 编码器配置,同时权衡检索质量、延迟、微调成本、对齐风险。
scenario_en: Choosing a CLIP encoder config for a domain catalog (fashion), weighing retrieval quality, latency, fine-tune cost, and alignment risk.
q: zero-shot / 联合微调双编码器 / 只微调图像 / 微调+区域特征,该怎么对比取舍？
q_en: How to compare zero-shot / fine-tune both / image-only / fine-tune+region configs?
why: zero-shot 当基线(中等质量、零微调成本、低风险);联合微调双编码器是生产目标(高质量,联合训练让两个空间一起动、抑制 drift);只微调图像风险最高(图像动、文本不动→alignment drift);微调+区域特征是精度上限但索引延迟+15-25ms。用延迟预算+目录专属度来定。
why_en: Zero-shot is the baseline, fine-tuning both encoders is the production target (joint training shifts both spaces together, limiting drift), image-only has the highest alignment-drift risk, and fine-tune+region is the accuracy ceiling at +15-25ms indexing.
tradeoff: 联合微调双编码器(高质量、抑制 drift) vs 只微调图像(省一半微调但 alignment drift 最高)
options: 四种配置检索质量一样,只是成本不同
zero-shot 基线;联合微调双编码器=生产目标(抑制 drift);只微调图像=风险最高;微调+区域=精度上限但索引更慢
只微调图像最优,因为省一半微调成本又不掉质量
永远选 zero-shot,微调纯属浪费
options_en: All four configs have equal retrieval quality, only cost differs.
Zero-shot baseline; fine-tune both = production target (limits drift); image-only = highest risk; fine-tune+region = accuracy ceiling but slower indexing.
Image-only is best: it halves fine-tune cost with no quality loss.
Always choose zero-shot; fine-tuning is pure waste.
optionExplanations: 四种配置质量差异明显(zero-shot 中、区域特征最高),不是仅成本不同。
对;这正是按质量/成本/对齐风险的四档取舍,联合微调是生产甜点,区域特征是精度天花板。
只微调图像会引入 alignment drift、跨模态检索退化,省成本却掉质量。
领域目录上联合微调显著提质,zero-shot 只是起点,不该永远停在基线。
optionExplanations_en: The four differ clearly in quality (zero-shot moderate, region highest), not just cost.
Correct — this is the four-way quality/cost/alignment-risk tradeoff: joint fine-tuning is the production sweet spot, region features the accuracy ceiling.
Image-only introduces alignment drift and degrades cross-modal retrieval — cheaper but lower quality.
Joint fine-tuning materially lifts quality on a domain catalog; zero-shot is only a start, not a permanent stop.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只微调一个编码器时,它的嵌入偏离另一个固定编码器的空间,破坏跨模态对齐。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Alignment drift is when fine-tuning one encoder shifts its embeddings away from the other fixed encoder's space, breaking cross-modal alignment.

scenario: 有一个特定领域商品目录(时尚服饰),zero-shot CLIP 检索质量只是中等,想提上去又不想引入对齐风险。
scenario_en: You have a domain catalog (fashion apparel) where zero-shot CLIP retrieval is only moderate, and you want higher quality without adding alignment risk.
q: 该怎么微调 CLIP,既提检索质量又控制对齐风险？
q_en: How should you fine-tune CLIP to raise retrieval quality while controlling alignment risk?
why: 在目录图文对上做领域对比训练、同时微调图像和文本两个编码器。联合训练让两个空间一起漂移、保持对齐,把 alignment drift 压到中等;还要冻结温度参数防止相似度坍缩。只微调一侧才会引入高 drift。
why_en: Do domain contrastive training on catalog pairs while fine-tuning both encoders, so the two spaces shift together and stay aligned, keeping drift moderate.
tradeoff: 联合微调双编码器(高质量、两空间同步、抑制 drift) vs 只微调图像(省成本但 drift 高)
options: 只微调图像编码器,文本冻结,省一半算力
在目录图文对上做领域对比训练、联合微调两个编码器,两空间同步漂移保持对齐
只微调文本编码器,图像冻结
两个都冻结,只在上面加一个线性分类头
options_en: Fine-tune only the image encoder with text frozen, halving compute.
Do domain contrastive training on catalog pairs and fine-tune both encoders, so the two spaces shift together and stay aligned.
Fine-tune only the text encoder with the image frozen.
Freeze both and add a linear classification head on top.
whenOtherWins: 若下游只做图搜图(image-to-image)、根本不用跨模态文本对齐,那只微调图像编码器就够,不必付联合微调双编码器的成本。
whenOtherWins_en: If the downstream is image-to-image only and never uses cross-modal text alignment, fine-tuning just the image encoder suffices without the cost of tuning both.
optionExplanations: 只微调图像→图像空间漂走、文本不动→跨模态对齐被破坏,drift 最高。
对;联合微调让两空间一起动、保持对齐,是领域目录的生产级做法,还要冻温度防坍缩。
只微调文本同样单侧漂移,破坏对齐,和只微调图像一个毛病。
全冻结加线性头学不到领域检索所需的嵌入调整,提质有限。
optionExplanations_en: Image-only shifts the image space while text stays fixed, breaking cross-modal alignment — highest drift.
Correct — joint fine-tuning moves both spaces together and preserves alignment, the production approach for a domain catalog, plus freeze temperature to avoid collapse.
Text-only is also one-sided drift, breaking alignment — the same flaw as image-only.
Freezing both with a linear head can't learn the embedding shifts domain retrieval needs, so quality gains are limited.

termDefinitions.term: domain contrastive training / 领域对比训练
termDefinitions.meaning: 用本领域的图文匹配对继续做对比学习,让 CLIP 适配该目录的语义。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Domain contrastive training continues contrastive learning on in-domain image-text pairs to adapt CLIP to the catalog's semantics.

scenario: 联合微调双编码器时,如果放开 CLIP 对比损失里的温度参数一起学,训练容易出问题。
scenario_en: When fine-tuning both encoders, letting CLIP's contrastive temperature parameter train freely tends to cause trouble.
q: 领域微调时为什么要冻结温度参数？不冻会怎样？
q_en: Why freeze the temperature parameter during domain fine-tuning, and what if you don't?
why: 温度控制相似度分布的尖锐程度。领域微调时若让它自由学,容易把相似度分布压塌(similarity collapse)——所有对的余弦挤到一起、失去区分度,检索排序失效。冻结温度保住相似度尺度,让微调只调嵌入方向而非塌缩尺度。
why_en: Temperature controls how sharp the similarity distribution is, and letting it train freely during domain fine-tuning can collapse similarities together, destroying the ranking discriminability.
options: 温度无所谓,冻不冻结果一样
不冻温度可能让相似度分布坍缩、失去区分度,检索排序失效;冻结保住相似度尺度
冻温度是为了加快训练速度,和相似度无关
温度越大越好,应该放开让它一直增大
options_en: Temperature doesn't matter; frozen or not, the result is the same.
Not freezing can collapse the similarity distribution and lose discriminability, breaking retrieval ranking; freezing preserves the similarity scale.
Freezing temperature only speeds up training, unrelated to similarity.
Higher temperature is always better; let it grow freely.
optionExplanations: 温度直接决定相似度分布尖锐度,冻不冻对训练稳定性影响很大。
对;放开温度易 similarity collapse,冻结它让微调只调方向、保住排序区分度。
冻温度主要是防坍缩、稳住相似度尺度,不是为了提速。
温度不是越大越好,失控会抹平相似度差异,反而坏了检索。
optionExplanations_en: Temperature directly sets the sharpness of the similarity distribution, so freezing strongly affects training stability.
Correct — a free temperature risks similarity collapse; freezing it keeps fine-tuning to direction changes and preserves ranking discriminability.
Freezing temperature is mainly to prevent collapse and stabilize the similarity scale, not to speed training.
Bigger temperature isn't better; unbounded, it flattens similarity differences and harms retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对比损失里缩放相似度 logits 的标量,控制分布尖锐度;过度自由会导致相似度坍缩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Temperature is a scalar scaling similarity logits in the contrastive loss, controlling sharpness; left too free it collapses similarities.

termDefinitions.meaning: 所有样本的相似度被压到相近数值,失去区分度,检索无法排序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Similarity collapse is when all similarities squeeze to near-equal values, losing discriminability so retrieval can't rank.

scenario: 为省成本,团队只微调 CLIP 的图像编码器,文本编码器完全冻结。上线后发现图搜图很准,但拿图搜文本描述的跨模态检索明显退化。
scenario_en: To save cost the team fine-tunes only CLIP's image encoder, freezing the text encoder. In production image-to-image is accurate, but image-to-text cross-modal retrieval clearly degrades.
q: '图搜图准、跨模态退化'这个现象说明发生了什么？
q_en: What does 'image-to-image accurate but cross-modal degraded' indicate happened?
why: 这是 alignment drift:图像嵌入被微调推动、漂离了固定的文本嵌入空间。图搜图只用图像空间内部关系,所以还准;但跨模态余弦依赖两个空间对齐,图像一漂就不可靠了。修法是联合微调两个编码器,让空间一起动。
why_en: It's alignment drift: fine-tuning shifted the image embeddings away from the fixed text embedding space, so image-to-image (within one space) stays accurate while cross-modal cosine (needs alignment) degrades.
options: 文本编码器过拟合了,应该多训文本
图像分辨率下降导致,提高分辨率即可
alignment drift:图像嵌入漂离固定文本空间→图搜图(同空间)仍准、跨模态(需对齐)退化;修法是联合微调
ANN 索引损坏,重建索引即可恢复
options_en: The text encoder overfit; train text more.
Image resolution dropped; raising it fixes it.
Alignment drift: image embeddings shifted away from the fixed text space → image-to-image (same space) stays accurate, cross-modal (needs alignment) degrades; fix by fine-tuning jointly.
The ANN index is corrupted; rebuild it to recover.
optionExplanations: 文本编码器是被冻结的、根本没训,谈不上过拟合。
现象源于嵌入空间对齐被破坏,不是像素分辨率问题。
对;只微调图像→图像空间漂走→同模态检索不受影响、跨模态对齐坏掉,联合微调才治本。
ANN 索引没坏,图搜图还准就说明检索管线正常,问题在跨模态对齐。
optionExplanations_en: The text encoder was frozen and never trained, so overfitting doesn't apply.
The symptom comes from broken embedding-space alignment, not pixel resolution.
Correct — image-only fine-tuning drifts the image space, so within-modality retrieval is unaffected while cross-modal alignment breaks; joint fine-tuning is the fix.
The ANN index isn't corrupted — accurate image-to-image shows retrieval works; the issue is cross-modal alignment.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只在图像嵌入空间内找相似图,不涉及文本,故不受跨模态对齐影响。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Image-to-image retrieval finds similar images within the image embedding space only, so it's unaffected by cross-modal alignment.

scenario: 时尚/家具类目录,用户很在意纹理、图案、形状这些细粒度视觉属性,全图嵌入常常抓不准。
scenario_en: For a fashion/furniture catalog, users care about fine-grained texture, pattern, and shape that a full-image embedding often blurs.
q: 什么时候值得上区域特征(region features)？代价是什么？
q_en: When are region features worth it, and what do they cost?
why: 当目录是属性敏感型(时尚、家具)、要抓纹理/图案/形状时值得。区域特征用 RoI pooling 只编码目标区域而非整图,抓到全图嵌入糊掉的细节,是精度上限档。代价是每张图 +15-25ms 的索引延迟(注意是建库时的,不是查询时的)。
why_en: Worth it for attribute-sensitive catalogs (fashion, furniture) needing texture/pattern/shape: region features use RoI pooling on the object region instead of the full image, at +15-25ms per-image indexing latency.
tradeoff: 区域特征(抓细粒度纹理/形状但 +15-25ms 索引) vs 全图嵌入(快但糊掉细节)
options: 任何目录都无脑上区域特征,越细越好
属性敏感目录(时尚/家具)要抓纹理/图案/形状时:RoI pooling 编码目标区域,代价是每图 +15-25ms 索引延迟
只在延迟预算极紧时上区域特征,因为它更快
区域特征只影响文本编码,和图像细节无关
options_en: Blindly use region features for any catalog; finer is always better.
For attribute-sensitive catalogs (fashion/furniture) needing texture/pattern/shape: RoI pooling encodes the object region, costing +15-25ms per-image indexing latency.
Only use region features under a tight latency budget because they're faster.
Region features only affect text encoding, unrelated to image detail.
whenOtherWins: 若目录是粗粒度品类(如'找一张沙发'不在乎具体纹理),全图嵌入已经够,区域特征只是白增索引延迟和算力。
whenOtherWins_en: If the catalog is coarse-grained (find 'a sofa' regardless of texture), full-image embeddings suffice and region features just add indexing latency and compute.
optionExplanations: 无脑上区域特征在粗粒度目录上白花索引算力,还不一定提质。
对;区域特征是属性敏感目录的精度上限,代价落在建库延迟而非查询延迟。
区域特征增加索引延迟,不是更快,选项把代价方向说反了。
区域特征作用在图像端抓细节,和文本编码无关,张冠李戴。
optionExplanations_en: Blind use wastes indexing compute on coarse catalogs without guaranteed gains.
Correct — region features are the accuracy ceiling for attribute-sensitive catalogs, with the cost on indexing latency, not query latency.
Region features add indexing latency, not speed — the option reverses the cost direction.
Region features act on the image side to capture detail, unrelated to text encoding — a mismatch.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只对目标框内区域做池化编码,得到聚焦局部细节(纹理/形状)的特征,而非整图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RoI (Region of Interest) pooling encodes only the object's bounding region to capture local detail (texture/shape) instead of the whole image.

scenario: 想领域适配 CLIP,但完整联合微调两个大编码器的算力/存储成本偏高,又担心微调破坏原有对齐。
scenario_en: You want to domain-adapt CLIP, but full joint fine-tuning of both large encoders is costly, and you fear it breaks the existing alignment.
q: 有没有介于'全量联合微调'和'完全冻结'之间的折中做法？
q_en: Is there a middle ground between full joint fine-tuning and full freezing?
why: 用 adapter 层:在冻结的编码器里插入少量可训练的小模块,只训这些 adapter。它是折中——微调成本远低于全量、又因为主干冻结而天然限制了 drift。质量介于 zero-shot 和全量联合微调之间。
why_en: Use adapter layers: insert small trainable modules into frozen encoders and train only those, which lowers fine-tune cost and, because the backbone is frozen, inherently limits drift.
tradeoff: adapter(低微调成本、限制 drift、质量中上) vs 全量联合微调(质量最高但成本高)
options: adapter 层:冻结主干、只训插入的小模块,微调成本低且天然限制 drift,质量介于 zero-shot 与全量微调之间
只能二选一:要么全量联合微调,要么完全 zero-shot,没有中间档
把学习率调到极大,快速全量微调一遍就好
只微调图像编码器当折中,反正省一半
options_en: Adapter layers: freeze the backbone and train only inserted small modules — low fine-tune cost and inherently limited drift, quality between zero-shot and full fine-tuning.
It's binary: either full joint fine-tuning or pure zero-shot, no middle ground.
Just set a huge learning rate and do one fast full fine-tune.
Fine-tune only the image encoder as the middle ground since it halves cost.
whenOtherWins: 若领域与预训练分布差得很远、需要大幅重塑嵌入,adapter 的容量可能不够,这时全量联合微调更合适。
whenOtherWins_en: If the domain is far from the pretraining distribution and embeddings must shift a lot, adapters may lack capacity and full joint fine-tuning fits better.
optionExplanations: 对;adapter 只训小模块、冻主干,兼顾低成本和低 drift,是标准折中。
adapter 正是二者之间的第三档,'只能二选一'忽略了它。
调大学习率的全量微调更易破坏对齐,不是稳妥折中。
只微调图像会引入 alignment drift,不是安全折中,和 adapter 目的相反。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — adapters train small modules with a frozen backbone, balancing low cost and low drift — the standard middle ground.
Adapters are exactly that third option between the two; 'binary' ignores them.
A huge-LR full fine-tune more easily breaks alignment — not a safe middle ground.
Image-only fine-tuning introduces alignment drift — not a safe middle ground and opposite to adapters' purpose.

termDefinitions.meaning: 插入冻结主干中的少量可训练小模块,只训它们即可低成本领域适配、限制漂移。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Adapter layers are small trainable modules inserted into a frozen backbone; training only them gives low-cost domain adaptation with limited drift.

scenario: 面试官想听你怎么把三种编码器配置摆成一条演进路线,而不是纠结哪个'最好'。
scenario_en: The interviewer wants you to lay the three configs on an evolution path rather than argue which is 'best'.
q: zero-shot / 联合微调 / 区域特征,分别对应产品的哪个阶段？
q_en: Zero-shot / joint fine-tuning / region features each map to which product stage?
why: 把它们摆成一条线:zero-shot 当原型/基线(零成本先跑通),联合微调当生产目标(领域上提质、抑制 drift),区域特征当精度上限(属性敏感目录才付它的索引成本)。最终由延迟预算+目录专属度来定停在哪一档,而不是笼统说哪个最好。
why_en: Present them as a path: zero-shot as prototype/baseline, joint fine-tuning as the production target, region features as the accuracy ceiling — letting latency budget and catalog specificity decide where to stop.
tradeoff: 沿 zero-shot→联合微调→区域特征逐档提质(成本递增) vs 一步到顶(索引/微调成本浪费)
options: 三种配置互斥,生产里只能选一个永远用
zero-shot=原型基线;联合微调=生产目标(提质抑 drift);区域特征=精度上限(属性敏感目录才用);由延迟预算+目录专属度定档
永远直接上区域特征,一步到位最省事
三种没区别,随便选一个即可
options_en: The three are mutually exclusive; production picks one forever.

Zero-shot = prototype baseline; joint fine-tuning = production target (quality + limits drift); region features = accuracy ceiling (attribute-sensitive catalogs); latency budget + catalog specificity decide the stop.
Always jump straight to region features to be done in one step.
The three are indistinguishable; pick any.
whenOtherWins: 若是快速验证一个新品类、还没打算投微调,就该停在 zero-shot 这一档先跑通体验,不必立刻上联合微调或区域特征。
whenOtherWins_en: For quickly validating a new category with no plan to invest in fine-tuning, stop at zero-shot to prove the experience before joint fine-tuning or region features.
optionExplanations: 三档是一条演进路线而非互斥,可随需求沿线推进。
对;基线→生产→上限的演进,由延迟预算和目录专属度决定停在哪,是成熟的表述。
一步上区域特征在不需要细粒度的目录上白花索引成本,不该无脑到顶。
三档质量/成本差异明显,不是没区别可随便选。
optionExplanations_en: The three are an evolution path, not mutually exclusive, advanced along as needs grow.
Correct — baseline → production → ceiling, with latency budget and catalog specificity deciding where to stop, is the mature framing.
Jumping to region features wastes indexing cost on catalogs that don't need fine detail — no blind maxing.
The three differ clearly in quality/cost, so they aren't interchangeable picks.

scenario: 目录有海量商品,不可能对每个候选都跑昂贵的融合打分。
scenario_en: The catalog has huge item counts, so running the expensive fusion score on every candidate is impossible.
q: 视觉搜索的检索为什么要分两阶段,各做什么？
q_en: Why is visual-search retrieval two-stage, and what does each stage do?
why: 两阶段:先用快速 ANN 检索,在整个目录里粗召回 top-k(约 100-500)候选;再用一个更有表达力的 re-ranker 对这几百个候选精细重排。ANN 便宜但粗,重排贵但准——只对短名单跑贵的打分,兼顾规模与相关性。
why_en: Two stages: fast ANN retrieval coarsely recalls the top-k (100-500) from the whole catalog, then a more expressive re-ranker finely reorders those few hundred, so the costly scoring runs only on a shortlist.
options: 只跑一次 ANN 就直接返回,不需要重排
先快速 ANN 粗召回 top-k(约 100-500),再用更强的 re-ranker 对短名单精排,兼顾规模与相关性
先对全目录跑 re-ranker,再用 ANN 采样
两阶段都用同一个模型跑两遍,只是重复
options_en: Run ANN once and return directly, no re-ranking needed.
Fast ANN coarsely recalls the top-k (100-500), then a stronger re-ranker finely reorders the shortlist, balancing scale and relevance.
Run the re-ranker over the whole catalog first, then sample with ANN.
Run the same model twice in both stages — just repetition.
optionExplanations: 只用 ANN 会漏掉重排能纠正的相关性,原始余弦受 modality gap 影响不够准。
对;ANN 收窄到短名单、re-ranker 精排,只对几百个跑贵打分,是两阶段标准解。
顺序颠倒:re-ranker 只能跑短名单,不可能先对全目录跑再采样。
两阶段用不同模型各司其职,不是同一模型重复跑。
optionExplanations_en: ANN-only misses the relevance re-ranking corrects, since raw cosine is biased by the modality gap.
Correct — ANN narrows to a shortlist and the re-ranker finely reorders, running the costly score on only a few hundred — the standard two-stage solution.
Order reversed: the re-ranker can only run on a shortlist, not the whole catalog before sampling.
The two stages use different models with distinct roles, not one model run twice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索:牺牲少量精确度,在海量向量里毫秒级召回相近候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) search trades a little exactness for millisecond recall of nearby candidates among massive vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对召回的短名单用更有表达力的打分函数重新排序,提升 top 结果相关性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A re-ranker reorders the recalled shortlist with a more expressive scoring function to improve top-result relevance.

scenario: re-ranker 要把多路信号融合成一个更好的排序分,先要说清它融合哪几路。
scenario_en: The re-ranker fuses several signals into a better ranking score; first be clear which ones.
q: 跨模态 re-ranker 融合哪三类分数？(多选)
q_en: Which three score types does the cross-modal re-ranker fuse? (multiple)
why: 三路:(1)visual similarity——查询图与候选图嵌入的余弦;(2)text relevance——候选元数据(标题/描述/标签)与查询上下文的匹配,用 BM25 或轻量 cross-encoder;(3)cross-modal alignment——查询图 CLIP 嵌入与候选文本 CLIP 嵌入的余弦。三路拼接后交给学习的融合模型。
why_en: Three: visual similarity (cosine of query-image and candidate-image embeddings), text relevance (candidate metadata vs query context via BM25 or a light cross-encoder), and cross-modal alignment (cosine of query-image CLIP embedding and candidate-text CLIP embedding).
options: visual similarity:查询图与候选图嵌入的余弦
text relevance:候选元数据与查询上下文的匹配(BM25 或轻量 cross-encoder)
cross-modal alignment:查询图 CLIP 嵌入与候选文本 CLIP 嵌入的余弦
server latency:候选所在服务器的响应延迟,越低排越前
options_en: Visual similarity: cosine of query-image and candidate-image embeddings.
Text relevance: candidate metadata vs query context (BM25 or a light cross-encoder).
Cross-modal alignment: cosine of the query-image CLIP embedding and the candidate-text CLIP embedding.
Server latency: the candidate's server response time, ranked higher when lower.
optionExplanations: 对;图-图余弦是最直接的视觉相似度,来自召回阶段的嵌入。
对;候选标题/描述与查询上下文的文本匹配,补充纯视觉之外的语义。
对;图查询直接对候选文本描述做语义匹配,是提升最大的一路(需矫正 modality gap)。
错;服务器延迟是运维指标,与内容相关性无关,不该进排序分。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — image-to-image cosine is the most direct visual similarity, from the recall-stage embeddings.
Correct — matching candidate title/description to query context adds semantics beyond pure vision.
Correct — matching the image query to candidate text descriptions is the highest-lift signal (correcting the modality gap).
Wrong — server latency is an ops metric unrelated to content relevance and shouldn't enter the ranking score.

termDefinitions.meaning: 经典词频-逆文档频率检索打分函数,衡量查询词与文档的文本匹配强度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BM25 is a classic term-frequency/inverse-document-frequency retrieval score measuring text match between query and document.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把查询和候选拼在一起送进一个模型联合编码打分,比双塔更准但更慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cross-encoder jointly encodes the query and candidate together to score them, more accurate but slower than a dual-encoder.

scenario: 候选商品有文本描述(标题/标签)。你想让'描述与查询图的语义匹配'也参与排序,而不是只看图像像不像。
scenario_en: Candidates have text descriptions (titles/tags). You want 'how well the description semantically matches the query image' to affect ranking, not just how visually similar.
q: 该加哪一路分数来捕捉'候选描述与查询图的语义匹配'？
q_en: Which score captures 'candidate description semantically matching the query image'?
why: 加 cross-modal alignment 分数:算查询图的 CLIP 嵌入与候选文本的 CLIP 嵌入的余弦。它跨模态地把'这张图'和'这段描述'对上,是提升最大的一路。因为有 modality gap,不能盲信原始余弦,所以它作为一路特征喂给学习的融合模型去矫正。
why_en: Add the cross-modal alignment score: cosine between the query-image CLIP embedding and the candidate-text CLIP embedding, matching 'this image' to 'this description' across modalities — the highest-lift signal.
tradeoff: cross-modal alignment(捕捉图-文语义、提升最大但需文本前向) vs 只用图-图余弦(纯视觉、漏语义)
options: 只用图-图 visual similarity,文本描述不参与
cross-modal alignment:查询图 CLIP 嵌入与候选文本 CLIP 嵌入的余弦,跨模态匹配图与描述
只按候选描述字数长短排序
用候选图片的文件大小当匹配分
options_en: Use only image-to-image visual similarity, with text descriptions excluded.
Cross-modal alignment: cosine of the query-image CLIP embedding and candidate-text CLIP embedding, matching image to description across modalities.
Rank by the character length of the candidate description.
Use the candidate image's file size as the match score.
whenOtherWins: 若候选普遍没有可靠文本元数据(如纯图库、无标题标签),cross-modal alignment 无文本可对,这时只能主要靠图-图 visual similarity。
whenOtherWins_en: If candidates mostly lack reliable text metadata (a pure image bank with no titles/tags), there's nothing to align to and you lean mainly on image-to-image visual similarity.
optionExplanations: 只用图-图漏掉了描述里的语义,'红色真丝'这类文本约束抓不到。
对;cross-modal alignment 跨模态对上图与描述,是三路里提升最大的语义信号。
字数长短与相关性无关,是无信息的伪特征。
文件大小与语义匹配毫无关系,不能当排序分。
optionExplanations_en: Image-to-image only misses description semantics, missing text constraints like 'red silk'.
Correct — cross-modal alignment matches image to description across modalities, the highest-lift semantic signal of the three.
Description length is unrelated to relevance — an uninformative pseudo-feature.
File size has nothing to do with semantic match and can't be a ranking score.

termDefinitions.term: cross-modal alignment score / 跨模态对齐分
termDefinitions.meaning: 查询图嵌入与候选文本嵌入的跨模态余弦,衡量图与描述的语义匹配。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The cross-modal alignment score is the cross-modal cosine between the query-image embedding and candidate-text embedding, measuring image-to-description semantic match.

scenario: 把三路分数(visual/text/cross-modal)拼成特征后,要选一个融合模型学出最终排序分。
scenario_en: After concatenating the three scores (visual/text/cross-modal) into features, pick a fusion model to learn the final ranking score.
q: MLP 融合 vs GBDT(LambdaMART)融合,核心取舍在哪？
q_en: MLP fusion vs GBDT (LambdaMART) fusion — what's the core tradeoff?
why: MLP 融合(如 3 输入→64 隐→1 输出)端到端可微、能和编码器联合训练、相关性更好,但难调试。GBDT(LambdaMART)把三路当表格特征、迭代快、可解释(特征重要性)、易调试,但不能和编码器联合训练。取舍是联合可训/相关性 vs 可解释/迭代速度。
why_en: MLP fusion is end-to-end differentiable, jointly trainable with encoders, and gives better relevance but is harder to debug; GBDT (LambdaMART) treats the scores as tabular features — fast to iterate, interpretable, easy to debug — but not jointly trainable.
tradeoff: MLP(可微、可联合训练、相关性好但难调试) vs GBDT/LambdaMART(可解释、迭代快、易调试但不能联合训练)
options: MLP 端到端可微、可与编码器联合训练、相关性好但难调试;GBDT(LambdaMART)可解释、迭代快、易调试但不能联合训练
两者完全等价,选哪个都一样
GBDT 可端到端可微并能与编码器联合训练,MLP 不行
MLP 一定更差,任何情况都该选 GBDT
options_en: MLP is end-to-end differentiable, jointly trainable with encoders, better relevance but harder to debug; GBDT (LambdaMART) is interpretable, fast to iterate, easy to debug but not jointly trainable.
The two are fully equivalent; pick either.
GBDT is end-to-end differentiable and jointly trainable with encoders; MLP is not.
MLP is always worse; always choose GBDT.
optionExplanations: 对;这正是'可微联合训练/相关性'与'可解释/迭代速度'的取舍,按团队需求选。
两者在可训性、可解释性、调试上差别明显,不等价。
说反了:MLP 才可微、可联合训练,GBDT 是树模型不可端到端联合训练。
GBDT 迭代快可解释,但相关性上限常不及联合训练的 MLP,不是永远更优。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — this is exactly the 'differentiable joint training / relevance' vs 'interpretability / iteration speed' tradeoff, chosen by team needs.
They differ clearly in trainability, interpretability, and debugging — not equivalent.
Backwards — MLP is differentiable and jointly trainable; GBDT is a tree model, not end-to-end jointly trainable.
GBDT iterates fast and is interpretable, but its relevance ceiling often trails a jointly-trained MLP — not always better.

termDefinitions.meaning: 梯度提升决策树:把特征当表格输入的强分类/排序器,可解释、迭代快。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GBDT (Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees) is a strong tabular classifier/ranker over feature inputs, interpretable and fast to iterate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于 GBDT 的排序学习算法,直接优化 NDCG 类排序指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LambdaMART is a GBDT-based learning-to-rank algorithm that directly optimizes NDCG-style ranking metrics.

scenario: cross-modal alignment 提升最大,但它要对每个候选做一次文本编码器前向;查询时几百个候选都现算会撑爆延迟预算。
scenario_en: Cross-modal alignment gives the most lift but needs a text-encoder forward pass per candidate; computing all few-hundred at query time blows the latency budget.
q: 怎么既用上 cross-modal alignment,又不让文本前向拖垮查询延迟？
q_en: How do you use cross-modal alignment without the text forward pass wrecking query latency?
why: 在建库(index)时就预计算并缓存每个候选的文本 CLIP 嵌入。查询时不再跑文本编码器,只把查询图嵌入与缓存的候选文本嵌入算余弦、再跑轻量融合模型。这样最贵的文本前向被挪到离线索引期,查询期只剩廉价点积——正是 Staff+ 会点出的优化。
why_en: Precompute and cache each candidate's text CLIP embedding at index time, so query time only does a cheap dot product against cached embeddings plus a light fusion model, moving the expensive text forward pass offline.
options: 查询时对每个候选实时跑文本编码器,靠加机器硬扛
干脆放弃 cross-modal alignment,只用图-图相似度
建库时预计算并缓存候选文本嵌入,查询时只算余弦+轻量融合,把文本前向挪到离线
把候选数从几百降到 3 个,减少文本前向次数
options_en: Run the text encoder in real time per candidate at query time, brute-forcing with more machines.
Just drop cross-modal alignment and use only image-to-image similarity.
Precompute and cache candidate text embeddings at index time; at query time only do cosine + light fusion, moving the text forward pass offline.
Cut candidates from a few hundred to 3 to reduce text forward passes.
optionExplanations: 查询时对每个候选现跑文本编码器,几百次前向必然超 10-30ms 预算,加机器成本高又难扩。
放弃 cross-modal alignment 等于丢掉提升最大的一路,得不偿失。
对;预计算缓存文本嵌入,把最贵的前向挪到离线索引期,查询只剩点积+轻量融合,延迟可控。
把候选砍到 3 个会严重伤召回,重排等于没得可排,治标不治本。
optionExplanations_en: Running the text encoder per candidate at query time means hundreds of forward passes that blow the 10-30ms budget, costly and hard to scale.
Dropping cross-modal alignment discards the highest-lift signal — a bad trade.
Correct — precomputing and caching text embeddings moves the costliest forward pass offline, leaving only dot products + light fusion at query time, keeping latency in budget.
Cutting candidates to 3 wrecks recall and leaves nothing to re-rank — a band-aid, not a fix.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在离线建库时把每个候选的嵌入/分数算好缓存,查询时直接取用,压低在线延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Index-time precomputation computes and caches each candidate's embeddings/scores offline so query time just looks them up, cutting online latency.

scenario: 多模态融合相比只用视觉,把 nDCG@10 提升了 8-12%;而 re-ranker 必须在 10-30ms 内跑完。
scenario_en: Multimodal fusion lifts nDCG@10 by 8-12% over vision-only, while the re-ranker must run within 10-30ms.
q: 这两个数字(nDCG@10 +8-12%、re-rank 10-30ms)怎么指导设计？
q_en: How do these numbers (nDCG@10 +8-12%, re-rank 10-30ms) guide design?
why: 8-12% 是经验提升量级、证明多模态融合值得做;10-30ms 是给定的在线延迟预算(SLO,不是公式)。两者合起来逼出'贵的文本前向必须离线预计算、查询时只留轻量融合'的设计——要在 10-30ms 里拿到 8-12% 的提升,就不能在查询期跑文本编码器。
why_en: The 8-12% is an empirical lift justifying multimodal fusion, and 10-30ms is a given online SLO (not a formula); together they force precomputing the expensive text forward pass offline so only light fusion runs within budget at query time.
options: 这两个数字要死记,考点是记住 8-12% 和 10-30ms
8-12% 说明多模态没用,应回退到纯视觉
8-12% 证明多模态融合值得做,10-30ms 是给定 SLO,两者逼出'文本前向离线预计算、查询只留轻量融合'
10-30ms 说明可以在查询时随便跑重模型,时间很充裕
options_en: Memorize the numbers; the point is recalling 8-12% and 10-30ms.
8-12% shows multimodal is useless; revert to vision-only.
8-12% justifies multimodal fusion and 10-30ms is a given SLO; together they force precomputing the text forward pass offline with only light fusion at query time.
10-30ms means you can run any heavy model at query time — plenty of time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只看前 10 个结果、按排位加权的排序质量指标,越靠前的相关项贡献越大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: nDCG@10 (normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain at 10) is a rank-weighted ranking-quality metric over the top 10, where relevant items nearer the top count more.

scenario: 要把排好序的结果变成可浏览、可筛选的体验:用户能按颜色、风格、品类勾选过滤。
scenario_en: You want to turn the ranked list into a browsable, filterable experience where users check color, style, category to filter.
q: 属性抽取(faceted 筛选)在架构上该怎么实现？
q_en: How should attribute extraction (faceted filtering) be implemented architecturally?
why: 在 CLIP 图像编码器的倒数第二层(penultimate)上接多任务分类头:共享 ViT 主干 → 若干并行的属性头(颜色/风格/品类),各自用多标签交叉熵。复用同一个检索编码器的表示,不必再训一个独立模型——一个编码器同时服务检索和筛选。
why_en: Attach multi-task classification heads on the CLIP image encoder's penultimate layer: a shared ViT backbone feeds parallel attribute heads (color/style/category) with multi-label cross-entropy, reusing the retrieval encoder for filtering too.
tradeoff: 复用编码器接属性头(一编码器多任务、省成本) vs 为筛选另训独立模型(重复算力)
options: 为每个属性单独训练一个从零的图像分类模型
在 CLIP 图像编码器倒数第二层接多任务分类头(颜色/风格/品类并行),复用同一检索编码器
让用户手动给每张图打属性标签,不用模型
把属性筛选做成查询时的实时目标检测,每次现算
options_en: Train a separate image classifier from scratch for each attribute.
Attach multi-task classification heads on the CLIP image encoder's penultimate layer (parallel color/style/category), reusing the same retrieval encoder.
Have users manually tag each image's attributes, no model.
Make attribute filtering real-time object detection at query time, recomputed each request.
whenOtherWins: 若某个属性和检索表示几乎无关、或需要 CLIP 主干抓不到的专门信号(如精确材质光谱),那单独训一个专用模型可能更合适。
whenOtherWins_en: If an attribute is nearly unrelated to the retrieval representation or needs a signal the CLIP backbone can't capture (precise material spectra), a dedicated model may fit better.
optionExplanations: 为每属性从零训模型重复造轮子,浪费算力,还没复用 CLIP 已学的丰富表示。
对;共享 ViT 主干接并行多任务头,一个编码器既检索又筛选,是成本高效的做法。
人工打标不可扩展,数十万商品无法逐张手标属性。
查询时实时检测把属性算力压到在线路径,拖垮延迟,应离线预计算。
optionExplanations_en: Training per-attribute models from scratch reinvents the wheel, wastes compute, and doesn't reuse CLIP's rich learned representation.
Correct — a shared ViT backbone with parallel multi-task heads lets one encoder both retrieve and filter — the cost-efficient approach.
Manual tagging doesn't scale; hundreds of thousands of items can't be hand-tagged per attribute.
Real-time detection at query time pushes attribute compute onto the online path, wrecking latency — precompute offline instead.

termDefinitions.meaning: 编码器输出前的那一层表示,常含丰富语义,适合接下游分类头。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The penultimate layer is the representation just before the encoder's output, often semantically rich and good for downstream heads.

termDefinitions.meaning: 共享主干上并行的多个任务专属输出头,各学一个属性,共用底层表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multi-task heads are parallel task-specific output heads on a shared backbone, each learning one attribute over the common representation.

scenario: 在 CLIP 图像主干上加属性头训练时,如果放开整个主干一起大幅微调,检索质量反而掉了。
scenario_en: Training attribute heads on the CLIP image backbone, fully fine-tuning the whole backbone actually degrades retrieval quality.
q: 训练属性头时,主干该怎么处理才不伤检索？不这么做会怎样？
q_en: How should the backbone be handled when training attribute heads, and what if not?
why: 主干要冻结、或只用 adapter 轻微调。因为大幅微调主干去拟合属性分类,会灾难性遗忘原本用于检索的嵌入——检索和筛选共用一个编码器,主干一被属性任务带偏,检索质量就崩。冻主干/adapter 让属性头学新任务、又保住检索表示。
why_en: Freeze the backbone or fine-tune it only lightly via adapters, because heavily fine-tuning it for attribute classification causes catastrophic forgetting of the retrieval embeddings shared by both tasks.
options: 放开整个主干大幅微调,属性和检索都会更好
主干冻结或只用 adapter 轻调:大幅微调会灾难性遗忘检索嵌入,共享编码器一被带偏检索就崩
把主干删掉,只留属性头独立训练
主干怎么调都行,检索和属性互不影响
options_en: Fully fine-tune the whole backbone; both attributes and retrieval improve.
Freeze the backbone or lightly adapt it: heavy fine-tuning causes catastrophic forgetting of retrieval embeddings, and the shared encoder collapses retrieval if pulled away.
Delete the backbone and train only the attribute heads standalone.
The backbone can be tuned any way; retrieval and attributes don't affect each other.
optionExplanations: 大幅微调主干去拟合属性会牺牲检索嵌入,不是双赢,检索反而退化。
对;冻主干/adapter 防灾难性遗忘,保住共享编码器的检索表示,属性头照常学。
删主干属性头就没有输入表示,检索也没了编码器,方案不成立。
两任务共享同一主干,主干被带偏检索必受影响,不是互不影响。
optionExplanations_en: Heavily fine-tuning the backbone for attributes sacrifices retrieval embeddings — not win-win; retrieval degrades.
Correct — freezing/adapting the backbone prevents catastrophic forgetting and preserves the shared encoder's retrieval representation while heads still learn.
Deleting the backbone leaves the heads with no input representation and retrieval with no encoder — the plan collapses.
Both tasks share one backbone, so pulling it away hurts retrieval — they aren't independent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 微调到新任务时模型抹掉了旧任务学到的能力,这里指主干忘掉检索嵌入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Catastrophic forgetting is when fine-tuning to a new task erases the model's prior ability, here the backbone forgetting retrieval embeddings.

scenario: 要为时尚商品设计颜色/风格/品类三个属性头,得说清每个头的输出形态。
scenario_en: Designing color/style/category attribute heads for fashion items, be clear on each head's output form.
q: 关于三个属性头的设计,哪些说法是对的？(多选)
q_en: Which statements about the three attribute heads are correct? (multiple)
why: 颜色头:固定调色板(20-30 个标准色),多标签(一件衣服可有多个主色);风格头:领域类目(休闲/正式/街头/复古);品类头:商品类型,精度最高(品类视觉最显著,最好分)。三个头并行接在共享主干上,各用多标签交叉熵。
why_en: Color head: a fixed palette (20-30 canonical colors), multi-label for multiple dominant colors; style head: domain categories (casual/formal/streetwear/vintage); category head: product type with the highest accuracy since category is most visually salient.
options: 颜色头:固定调色板(20-30 个标准色),多标签(一件可多个主色)
风格头:领域类目(休闲/正式/街头/复古)
品类头:商品类型,通常精度最高,因为品类视觉上最显著
所有属性头都必须是单标签 softmax,一张图只能有一个颜色
options_en: Color head: a fixed palette (20-30 canonical colors), multi-label (an item can have several dominant colors).
Style head: domain categories (casual/formal/streetwear/vintage).
Category head: product type, usually the highest accuracy because category is most visually salient.
All heads must be single-label softmax; an image can have only one color.
optionExplanations: 对;颜色用固定调色板+多标签,能同时标出一件衣服的多个主色。
对;风格是领域约定的类目,按业务定义那几档。
对;品类视觉最显著、最好分,精度通常在三个头里最高。
错;颜色恰恰是多标签的,强制单标签会丢掉多主色信息。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — color uses a fixed palette with multi-label, capturing several dominant colors of one item.
Correct — style is a set of domain-defined categories per business definition.
Correct — category is most visually salient and easiest to separate, usually the highest-accuracy head.
Wrong — color is inherently multi-label; forcing single-label loses multi-color information.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个样本可同时属于多个类别(如一件衣服既红又白),用多标签交叉熵。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multi-label means one item can belong to several classes at once (an item both red and white), trained with multi-label cross-entropy.

scenario: 属性筛选要求用户勾选颜色/风格就能瞬间过滤,不能每次都现跑属性头。
scenario_en: Faceted filtering must filter instantly when users check color/style, not run the attribute heads each time.
q: 属性该在什么时候算,才能让 faceted 筛选零查询延迟？
q_en: When should attributes be computed so faceted filtering has zero query latency?
why: 在离线建库(indexing)时就把每张图的属性算好、和元数据一起存起来。查询时 faceted 筛选只是查预存字段(颜色=红 AND 风格=复古),零推理延迟。区域特征虽提升属性精度,但也只增加建库算力、不碰查询延迟。
why_en: Precompute attributes offline during indexing and store them with metadata, so faceted filtering at query time just queries precomputed fields (color=red AND style=vintage) with zero inference latency.
options: 查询时对每个结果实时跑属性头,保证最新
离线建库时预算好属性、随元数据存;查询时只查预存字段,零推理延迟
让用户勾选后再触发属性计算,边筛边算
把属性算力放在 CDN 边缘节点,每次请求现算
options_en: Run the attribute heads in real time on each result at query time to stay fresh.
Precompute attributes offline during indexing and store with metadata; at query time just query precomputed fields, zero inference latency.
Trigger attribute computation after the user checks a facet, computing as they filter.
Put attribute compute on CDN edge nodes, recomputed each request.
optionExplanations: 查询时现跑属性头把推理压到在线路径,筛选就不可能瞬时,违背零延迟目标。
对;建库预算好属性存字段,查询只做字段过滤,faceted 筛选零推理延迟。
勾选后再算=把延迟推给交互瞬间,用户体验照样卡顿。
边缘现算仍是查询期推理,分散节点也改变不了'该离线预算'这一点。
optionExplanations_en: Running heads at query time pushes inference onto the online path, so filtering can't be instant — violating the zero-latency goal.
Correct — precompute attributes into stored fields at index time so query time only field-filters, giving zero-inference faceted filtering.
Computing after a click just moves latency to the interaction moment, still janky.
Edge computation is still query-time inference; distributing nodes doesn't change that it should be precomputed offline.

scenario: 区域特征把 Pinterest 的颜色属性精度提升约 12%,但每张图要多花约 15-25ms 编码。
scenario_en: Region features lift Pinterest's color-attribute accuracy by ~12% but add ~15-25ms of encoding per image.
q: '+12% 精度、+15-25ms' 这组数字落在系统的哪条路径上,意味着什么？
q_en: On which path does '+12% accuracy, +15-25ms' fall, and what does it mean?
why: +12% 颜色精度是经验提升,+15-25ms 落在建库(indexing)路径、不是查询路径。因为属性和区域特征都在离线建库时预算好,这点延迟只增加索引吞吐成本,用户查询延迟完全不受影响。所以属性敏感目录值得为精度付这份离线成本。
why_en: The +12% color accuracy is an empirical lift and the +15-25ms falls on the indexing path, not query, since attributes and region features are precomputed offline — so it raises indexing cost while user query latency is untouched.
options: +15-25ms 落在查询路径,会拖慢用户搜索,得谨慎
这两个数字要死记,考点是记住 12% 和 15-25ms
+15-25ms 落在离线建库路径、不碰查询延迟;属性敏感目录值得为 +12% 精度付这份离线成本
+12% 精度说明区域特征无用,提升太小
options_en: The +15-25ms falls on the query path and slows user search, so be cautious.
Memorize the numbers; the point is recalling 12% and 15-25ms.
The +15-25ms falls on the offline indexing path and never touches query latency; attribute-sensitive catalogs are worth the offline cost for +12% accuracy.
The +12% shows region features are useless — too small a lift.

termDefinitions.meaning: 离线把商品编码、算好特征/属性并写入索引的流程,其延迟不影响在线查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The indexing path is the offline flow that encodes items and computes features/attributes into the index; its latency doesn't affect online queries.

scenario: 面试官想听一个 Staff+ 级的成本效率论点:同一个 CLIP 编码器怎么同时喂检索和属性筛选两条下游。
scenario_en: The interviewer wants a Staff+ cost-efficiency argument: how one CLIP encoder feeds both retrieval and attribute filtering.
q: '一个编码器服务多个下游任务'这个论点,好在哪？
q_en: What's the strength of the 'one encoder serves multiple downstream tasks' argument?
why: 同一个 CLIP 图像编码器既产出检索嵌入,又在其倒数第二层接属性头做筛选——一份编码算力被两条下游(检索+属性)共享。不用为筛选另训另跑一个独立模型,省训练、省服务算力、省维护,是 Staff+ 的成本效率论点。
why_en: One CLIP image encoder produces retrieval embeddings and feeds attribute heads on its penultimate layer, so a single encoding pass is shared by both downstreams — no separate model to train, serve, and maintain for filtering.
tradeoff: 一编码器多任务(共享算力、省训练/服务/维护) vs 每任务独立模型(隔离但重复算力与维护)
options: 一个 CLIP 编码器同时喂检索嵌入和属性头,一份编码被两条下游共享,省训练/服务/维护算力
为每个下游各训各跑一个独立编码器,互不干扰最稳
编码器只该做检索,属性必须用另一套完全独立的视觉系统
把编码器换成规则引擎,省掉所有模型
options_en: One CLIP encoder feeds both retrieval embeddings and attribute heads, sharing one encoding pass across both downstreams, saving training/serving/maintenance compute.
Train and serve a separate encoder per downstream for maximum isolation.
The encoder should only do retrieval; attributes need a completely separate vision system.
Replace the encoder with a rule engine to drop all models.
whenOtherWins: 若某下游任务的需求与检索表示强烈冲突、共享主干会互相拖累(如属性需要大幅重塑主干),那为它单独拆一个模型反而更好。
whenOtherWins_en: If a downstream's needs strongly conflict with the retrieval representation and sharing hurts both (attributes needing a heavily reshaped backbone), a separate model for it is better.
optionExplanations: 对;共享一份编码给检索和属性,省掉重复训练/服务/维护,是标准的成本效率论点。
每任务独立编码器隔离但重复算力和维护,规模上不划算。
属性头正是复用检索编码器表示的,另起独立视觉系统是浪费。
规则引擎抓不到视觉语义,替代不了 CLIP 编码器,方向错误。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — sharing one encoding across retrieval and attributes avoids duplicate training/serving/maintenance — the standard cost-efficiency argument.
Per-task encoders isolate but duplicate compute and maintenance, uneconomical at scale.
Attribute heads precisely reuse the retrieval encoder's representation; a separate vision system is wasteful.
A rule engine can't capture visual semantics and can't replace the CLIP encoder — wrong direction.

q: 把视觉搜索的查询期(query-time)流程排成正确顺序:
q_en: Order the visual-search query-time flow correctly:
steps: 查询图过 CLIP 图像编码器,得到 query 嵌入
用 query 嵌入做 ANN 检索,召回 top-k(100-500)候选
取出候选在建库时预计算好的文本嵌入与视觉嵌入
融合三路分数(visual/text/cross-modal)跑轻量 re-ranker 重排
返回重排结果,并用预存属性做 faceted 筛选
why: 查询期:编码查询图 → ANN 召回短名单 → 取候选预计算好的嵌入/分数 → 轻量融合重排 → 返回+属性筛选。关键是把贵的文本前向和属性都放在建库期预计算,查询期只剩编码查询图 + 廉价点积 + 轻量融合,压在 10-30ms 内。
why_en: Query time: encode the query image, ANN-recall a shortlist, fetch candidates' precomputed embeddings/scores, run light fusion re-ranking, and return with attribute filtering — the expensive text forward pass and attributes are precomputed at index time.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["编码查询图"] --> B["ANN 召回 top-k"]
  B --> C["取候选预计算嵌入/分数"]
  C --> D["融合三路分数轻量重排"]
  D --> E["返回 + 属性筛选"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户发起搜索到返回结果之间在线执行的步骤,受严格延迟预算约束。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Query-time is the online steps between a user's search and the returned results, bound by a strict latency budget.

scenario: re-ranker 上线后排序偶尔出怪结果,团队需要快速定位是哪一路分数在作怪,并频繁迭代调特征。
scenario_en: After launch the re-ranker occasionally ranks oddly, and the team needs to quickly pinpoint which score misbehaves and iterate on features often.
q: 这种'要可解释、要快速迭代调试'的场景,融合模型更该选哪个？
q_en: For 'need interpretability and fast debug iteration', which fusion model fits better?
why: 选 GBDT(LambdaMART):它把三路当表格特征,给出特征重要性,能直接看出是 visual、text 还是 cross-modal 那一路主导了怪排序;树模型迭代快、易调试。代价是不能和编码器端到端联合训练,相关性上限略低于 MLP。
why_en: Choose GBDT (LambdaMART): it treats the three as tabular features and gives feature importance, so you can see which score drives the odd ranking, and it iterates fast and debugs easily — at the cost of no joint training with encoders.
tradeoff: GBDT(可解释、迭代快、易调试但不可联合训练) vs MLP(相关性上限高但难调试、需联合训练)
options: 选 MLP,因为它端到端可微、最好调试
选 GBDT(LambdaMART):特征重要性可解释、迭代快易调试,能定位哪路分数作怪
选纯规则加权,手写每路权重,不用学习
两个都不选,直接砍掉 text 和 cross-modal 只留视觉
options_en: Choose MLP because it's end-to-end differentiable and easiest to debug.
Choose GBDT (LambdaMART): interpretable feature importance, fast to iterate and debug, pinpointing which score misbehaves.
Choose pure rule weighting, hand-tuning each score's weight, no learning.
Choose neither; just drop text and cross-modal and keep vision only.
whenOtherWins: 若目标是把相关性顶到最高、且愿意和编码器端到端联合训练、也能接受较难调试,那 MLP 融合更合适。
whenOtherWins_en: If the goal is maxing relevance with end-to-end joint training and you accept harder debugging, MLP fusion fits better.
optionExplanations: MLP 恰恰更难调试、不可解释,'最好调试'说反了。
对;GBDT 的特征重要性直接告诉你哪路分数主导,迭代快,契合可解释+快速调试的诉求。
手写权重没有数据驱动,难以跟上分布变化,也不比学习模型好调。
砍掉 text/cross-modal 会丢掉 8-12% 的多模态提升,因噎废食。
optionExplanations_en: MLP is actually harder to debug and not interpretable, so 'easiest to debug' is backwards.
Correct — GBDT's feature importance directly reveals which score dominates and it iterates fast, matching the interpretability + fast-debug need.
Hand-tuned weights aren't data-driven, lag distribution shifts, and aren't easier to tune than a learned model.
Dropping text/cross-modal loses the 8-12% multimodal lift — throwing out the baby with the bathwater.

scenario: re-ranker 很贵(融合三路分数),而目录有百万级商品;ANN 召回 top-k 一般取 100-500。
scenario_en: The re-ranker is expensive (fusing three scores) while the catalog has millions of items; ANN recalls a top-k of typically 100-500.
q: 为什么 ANN 只召回几百个短名单交给 re-ranker,而不是把全目录都重排？
q_en: Why does ANN recall only a few-hundred shortlist for the re-ranker instead of re-ranking the whole catalog?
why: re-ranker 每个候选都要融合三路分数、成本远高于 ANN 点积。百万级全量重排既超延迟预算又浪费——大多数商品明显不相关。ANN 先廉价收窄到 100-500 个真正相近的,再把贵的重排只花在这份短名单上,兼顾召回覆盖与延迟。
why_en: The re-ranker fuses three scores per candidate, far costlier than ANN's dot product, so re-ranking millions blows the latency budget and wastes effort on obviously irrelevant items — ANN cheaply narrows to 100-500 truly-near items first.
tradeoff: ANN 收窄到短名单再重排(省贵算力、守延迟) vs 全目录重排(覆盖全但超预算、浪费在不相关项)
options: 因为 re-ranker 便宜,全目录重排也没关系,只是习惯取 100-500
re-ranker 每候选融合三路成本高,全量重排超延迟预算且浪费;ANN 先廉价收窄到 100-500 再精排
因为 ANN 只能返回 100-500 个,是硬性上限,和成本无关
为了让结果多样性更高才限制候选数
options_en: Because the re-ranker is cheap, whole-catalog re-ranking is fine; 100-500 is just habit.
The re-ranker fuses three scores per candidate at high cost, so whole-catalog re-ranking blows the budget and wastes effort; ANN cheaply narrows to 100-500 first.
Because ANN can only ever return 100-500 items, a hard cap unrelated to cost.
To increase result diversity, which is why candidates are capped.
whenOtherWins: 若目录很小(几千条)、re-ranker 又轻,那直接对全目录重排也跑得完,ANN 收窄的意义就不大。
whenOtherWins_en: If the catalog is tiny (a few thousand) and the re-ranker is light, re-ranking the whole catalog is feasible and ANN narrowing matters little.
optionExplanations: re-ranker 并不便宜,融合三路分数的成本正是要限候选数的原因,不是习惯。
对;贵的重排只该花在 ANN 收窄后的短名单上,兼顾覆盖与延迟。
ANN 的 top-k 是可调参数,不是固定 100-500 的硬上限,归因错误。
限候选数是为了省重排算力/守延迟,不是为了多样性。
optionExplanations_en: The re-ranker isn't cheap; the cost of fusing three scores is exactly why candidates are capped — not habit.
Correct — the costly re-rank should run only on the ANN-narrowed shortlist, balancing coverage and latency.
ANN's top-k is a tunable parameter, not a fixed 100-500 hard cap — wrong attribution.
Capping candidates saves re-rank compute and protects latency, not for diversity.

scenario_en: Wrap-up: one line tying together the three decisions and key tradeoffs of the visual-search architecture.
q: 补全生产级视觉搜索的架构骨架:
q_en: Fill in the skeleton of production visual search:
text: 架构三决策:(1)CLIP 编码器配置——生产用{{联合微调}}双编码器抑制 alignment {{drift}};(2)两阶段检索——{{ANN}} 召回 top-k 再跨模态 re-rank,融合 visual/text/cross-modal 三路,贵的文本前向{{预计算}}在建库期;(3)属性头做 faceted 筛选,主干{{冻结}}防灾难性遗忘,属性离线算好、查询零延迟。
text_en: Three decisions: (1) CLIP encoder config — production uses {{joint fine-tuning}} of both encoders to limit alignment {{drift}}; (2) two-stage retrieval — {{ANN}} recalls top-k then cross-modal re-rank fusing visual/text/cross-modal, with the costly text forward pass {{precomputed}} at index time; (3) attribute heads for faceted filtering with the backbone {{frozen}} to prevent catastrophic forgetting, attributes precomputed offline for zero query latency.
why: 一句话骨架:联合微调控 drift、两阶段 ANN+re-rank 融合三路且离线预计算贵的一路、属性头冻主干做零延迟筛选。核心贯穿主线是'把贵的算力挪到建库期,查询期只留轻量'。
why_en: The one-line skeleton: joint fine-tuning limits drift, two-stage ANN + re-rank fuses three scores with the expensive one precomputed, and attribute heads on a frozen backbone give zero-latency filtering — all by moving cost to index time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先 ANN 快速召回短名单,再用更强的 re-ranker 精排,兼顾规模与相关性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Two-stage retrieval first recalls a shortlist via ANN, then finely reorders with a stronger re-ranker, balancing scale and relevance.
